# allinkl_domain_settings (Resource)

Manages the host settings of a domain that exists in the KAS account: document root or redirect, PHP version and activation. It does not register, transfer or delete the domain; destroying the resource only forgets the domain and leaves its settings as they are.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The domain exists in the account already; the resource adopts its settings.
resource "allinkl_domain_settings" "main" {
  domain      = "example.com"
  path        = "/example.com/"
  php_version = "8.4"
}

output "example_com_uses_lets_encrypt" {
  value = allinkl_domain_settings.main.tls.lets_encrypt
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) A domain hosted in the KAS account. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the host is served.
- `path` (String) Document root path relative to the account root, or the redirect target URL when `redirect_status` is set.
- `php_version` (String) PHP version the host runs, e.g. `8.4`. Left unset, KAS chooses; the API documents 7.1 as its default.
- `redirect_status` (Number) Redirect status: `0` (no redirect), `301`, `302` or `307`. With a redirect, `path` holds the target URL.

### Read-Only

- `dkim_selector` (String) Selector of the DKIM key KAS signs mail with.
- `id` (String) The domain name.
- `tls` (Attributes) TLS state of the host, as KAS reports it. Managed with `allinkl_tls_certificate`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tls))

<a id="nestedatt--tls"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tls`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the certificate is served.
- `force_https` (Boolean) Whether HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.
- `hsts_max_age` (Number) HSTS max-age in seconds; `-1` when HSTS is off.
- `lets_encrypt` (Boolean) Whether the certificate was issued by Let's Encrypt through the KAS panel.
- `type` (String) Certificate type as KAS names it; `LE90D` is a Let's Encrypt certificate issued through the panel.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import allinkl_domain_settings.main example.com
```
